LLM Training Job Economic Metrics.flops_explanation: Level 2 of 5 (Light), comparable to a small fine-tuning run on non-production grade hardware (hardware References: NVIDIA RTX 3060/4060/4070; AMD RX 7600/7800 XT). A FLOP is one arithmetic operation (an add or multiply) on a decimal number; this job performed about 1.8e+15 of them. That is roughly 14.3 seconds of work for one NVIDIA A100 GPU at typical efficiency, or about 5.7e-07% of the compute used to train GPT-3.
LLM Training Job Economic Metrics.carbon_explanation: About 0.01 km of driving in an average gasoline car. Inputs: 1 GPU(s) at 143 W (measured); 65 W CPU (assumed); grid intensity 0.4 kg CO2e/kWh.
